note: Original demo diary (Neuro 85, 2026-10-27): invented people and events, written for the Plasmem demo; free to show publicly. Each session = one chat between Maya and Sam on that date.

turns: Guess what, I got the job at the Riverside clinic! I start on Tuesday.
That's huge, congratulations! Front desk or with the patients?
Patient intake, so a lot of forms at first. The manager, Dr. Okafor, seems really kind.
We should celebrate. Dinner at that Thai place on Friday?
Yes please, I've been craving their green curry for weeks.
How was the weekend with your sister?
Lena and I hiked Mount Tam on Saturday, the full Dipsea loop, fourteen miles.
Fourteen miles! Are your legs still working?
Barely. Lena didn't even look tired, she runs every morning.
I did, the fog over the ocean at the summit was unreal. I'll print one for the hallway.
Big news from Lena: she's moving to Lisbon in the spring to start a PhD in marine biology.
Wow, Portugal. How do you feel about it?
Proud of her, but I'll miss our Sunday calls being in the same time zone.
We could visit her. I've always wanted to see Lisbon.
Let's look at flights once she has an apartment.
I finally fixed the back brake on my bike, it only took three YouTube videos.
No, it turned out the pads were glazed. I sanded them and it stops perfectly now.
Great, then we can ride to the farmers market on Saturday.
Deal. I want to get those heirloom tomatoes again.
Work is getting busier. We switched to a new records system and nobody knows how it works.
She stayed late with me twice to fix my login. I really like her.
Also, did you book the dentist? You said your tooth was bothering you.
Ugh, yes. October 23rd at 9 in the morning. I hate dentists.
Lena got the Gulbenkian scholarship! Her tuition in Lisbon is fully covered.
That's amazing, tell her congratulations from me.
She was crying on the phone. She worked so hard on that application.
Late February, so she can find an apartment before the term starts in March.
I tried making your grandmother's lentil soup tonight.
And? How did it turn out?
Way too salty. I think I used stock cubes and salt, and the recipe only wanted one.
Grandma would have laughed. Add potatoes next time, they soak up the salt.
Good tip. I'm also going to try her cardamom bread this weekend.
I signed up for a pottery class on Wednesday evenings. Six weeks.
Nice, will you make us mugs?
That's the plan, but the first class was only about centering the clay. Mine kept wobbling.
The teacher, Rosa, said I was too stiff in the wrists.
Lena came down on Sunday and we went climbing at the Mission Cliffs gym.
She did, on every single route. She did a 5.11 that I couldn't even start.
Did you at least get the slab one you were working on?
Yes! Finally topped it on my third try.
I looked at flights to Lisbon for April, about 700 dollars each if we book soon.
Let's do it. Lena says April is the best month there, before it gets hot.
I can only get ten days off. Let's say April 10 to April 20.
Okay, I'll hold the seats tonight.
The dentist was fine yesterday. No cavities, just a cracked old filling.
See, not so bad. Do they need to replace it?
Yes, in November. Dr. Patel said it's a twenty minute job.
Want to get ice cream after, as a reward?
Only if it's the salted caramel from Bi-Rite.
My mom called, she's coming to visit for Thanksgiving.
Five days. She wants to try the cardamom bread I've been practising.
Then you'd better practise more, the last loaf was a brick.
